package.name: nav2_graceful_controller
package.description: Minimal vendored slice of nav2_graceful_controller for Humble: only the SmoothControlLaw / EgocentricPolarCoordinates classes that opennav_docking depends on. Sources taken from the navigation2 humble branch. The full Iron controller plugin is intentionally omitted -- it does not build against the Nav2 1.1.5 sources vendored in this workspace, and the docking server only uses SmoothControlLaw.
